$comment: The commercial catalogue as data. Plans are never hard-coded into a service
or a component (docs/domain-model.md section 4); this file is what a fresh
deployment starts from, and everything after that is edited through the API.
Features listed here are identities only — what may be sold. The versioned,
deployable packages behind them arrive with the registry in phase 3.5, so a
feature published here is sellable, not yet shippable.
An operator may point at a different file with Catalogue:SeedPath.
